statement: Weekly case volume for the wholesale channel was 41,200 cases.
question: Does the warehouse figure agree with the number the regional sales lead has been reading off her own spreadsheet for years?
decision: Whether the warehouse system replaces that spreadsheet as the number the weekly ops review trusts.
grain: one number per calendar week, whole wholesale channel
_note: This is the dual run: a SYSTEM derivation (recomputed from the warehouse) held side by side with a THIRD_PARTY comparison against the incumbent artifact somebody already trusts, rather than a second SQL path against the same source. It ships with no database attached, so the derivation cannot run and G5.rederivation reports the source as missing, same as example-descriptive.json. G5.comparison still reaches a verdict: with nothing recomputed on the system side it is honestly NO-DATA, not a refusal of the non-SQL path. Point evidence.source at a real warehouse and G5.comparison compares the recomputed number against the incumbent's own value.

derivations.name: warehouse rollup
derivations.sql: select sum(cases) from fact_shipment where channel = 'wholesale' and week = '2026-W33'

comparison.incumbent: the regional sales lead's own weekly tracking spreadsheet

protocol.collection_method: manual weekly entry from delivery notes, not reconciled to the warehouse feed
protocol.coverage: wholesale channel only; does not include direct-to-consumer
protocol.known_biases: delivery notes lag the warehouse by up to two days near week boundaries, so the edge weeks run low

uncertainty.why: This is a census of recorded shipments, not a sample, so there is no sampling error to state. The open question is agreement with the incumbent spreadsheet, which G5.comparison answers directly.

not_established: Whether the two-day lag named in known_biases fully explains any drift between the warehouse figure and the spreadsheet was not separately tested.
Completeness of the warehouse feed itself against the wholesale channel's own shipment records was not reconciled.
